verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio integration, and nothing shows notes or summaries being matched to contact or deal records. The Developer API and webhooks are building blocks a developer could use to build such a sync. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
